prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production hero background illustration for Socially's Captain mobile Home screen, landscape 3:2, 1536 by 1024.
Primary request: a captain leading a voyage, in the same cinematic coastal fantasy realism as the app's Crew harbor, coastal-voyage auth and pale limestone Captain discovery artwork. Generate artwork only, no user interface.
Scene: the open deck of an elegant sailing vessel in a tranquil Mediterranean bay. On the right third stands a navy-cloaked Captain, seen from behind in three-quarter view, one hand resting on a beautifully crafted antique brass and dark wood ship's wheel. The coat has restrained brass maritime embroidery, realistic cloth folds, no readable insignia. Ahead: a white limestone island port with slender towers and arches, distant blue mountains, calm azure water, two small white-sailed ships accompanying the voyage. A subtle mast or sail edge only at far right; clear horizon and open water. The crew's harbor and this ship belong to one consistent world.
Composition: top 35 percent and left half have uncluttered pale blue sky and open airy water suitable for overlaying dark real app text. Captain and wheel occupy rightmost third, positioned around mid-height; torso and wheel should remain visible in a mobile cover crop. Important character silhouette and wheel between 45 and 80 percent of image width. Avoid a large dark silhouette occupying the center or lower left. Framing on a phone will be roughly 390px wide by 460px high, cover crop weighted 60% from left. Keep the main subject close enough to read in that crop. Landscape format, straight horizon.
Lighting and colors: soft early morning sunlight, powder blue sky, pearl ivory limestone, navy clothing, pale azure sea, restrained warm antique brass. Mostly cool, bright and serene; realistic materials and water, natural light. Painterly cinematic realism, quietly ambitious, premium and human.
Constraints: no text, typography, captions, app frame, numerical charts, holographic cards, coin symbols, logos, watermark, or aggressive warship/weapon imagery. Do not render app UI. Artwork must be distinctive from the Crew harbor while matching the same palette and craft.
